packages.label: JCodeMunch code intelligence
packages.description: Local code index with symbol search, outline, references, and context bundling. Blocks Grep/Glob and routes code exploration through jcodemunch tools.

packages.label: JDocMunch doc intelligence
packages.description: Local docs index with section search, TOC, and context retrieval. Routes doc exploration through jdocmunch tools instead of reading full files.

packages.label: Case study skill
packages.description: Bundles the case-study skill via a skill component — demonstrates a package whose payload is a shared skill link.

packages.label: /inventory Project Context
packages.description: Backs the /inventory command and gates Project Context orientation rules. Enables the project-context skill plus the rules that consult Project Context docs when present.

packages.label: Code intelligence
packages.description: Enables both the jcodemunch code index and the jdocmunch doc index together — a package that requires (composes) other packages.

packages.label: Telemetry
packages.description: Capture and visualize token usage across harnesses. Wires capture hooks and a local spool; the web portal is started separately with `roborepo serve`.

packages.label: Caveman plugin
packages.description: Claude plugin that keeps agent output terse to cut token use (statusline badge, /caveman commands, mode-tracker hook). Also gates the global caveman communication rule.

packages.label: Convention capture
packages.description: Agents surface newly confirmed conventions as an inline `> 📌 Capture candidate:` note during the chat. A Chat-Time Output behavior; merges its rules block into both harnesses.

packages.label: Impact awareness
packages.description: When you propose a change, agents flag (`> 🧭 Impact:`) how it collides with or duplicates existing functionality. A Chat-Time Output behavior; merges its rules block into both harnesses.

packages.label: Skill visibility
packages.description: Agents report which skills shaped a response (`> 🧩 Skills loaded:`) so behavior changes are traceable. A Chat-Time Output behavior; merges its rules block into both harnesses.
